setting: You, Fernanda, Matheus and Rogério all live in Recife, Brazil, and you are regular climbers at the same climbing gym there. You know each other from sessions on the bouldering wall, where you have trained together for a couple of years, and you use this group chat to plan climbs and rides to the gym.
opener: asking who wants to climb at the gym after work on Thursday.

Fernanda.knows: You know Matheus as a regular climber, a civil engineering student about 27, and Rogério as a regular climber and gym instructor about 45.
Fernanda.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly replying when someone else brings up a plan.

Matheus.knows: You know Fernanda as a regular climber and pharmacist about 31, and Rogério as a regular climber and gym instructor about 45.
Matheus.texts: You message in this chat mostly when plans come up, not unprompted.

Rogério.knows: You know Fernanda as a regular climber and pharmacist about 31, and Matheus as a regular climber and civil engineering student about 27.
Rogério.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually to share something from the gym or a route you've set.

private_lines.Fernanda: You work as a pharmacist in Recife, with some shifts running late into the evening. You live alone in a city apartment and fill your free time with climbing, the gym and friends.
private_lines.Matheus: You are a civil engineering student at a university in Recife, with classes during the day and study at home in the evenings. You live alone in a rented flat and climb at the gym a few evenings a week.
private_lines.Rogério: You teach classes at the gym most mornings and evenings in Recife. You live alone in an apartment and spend most of your waking hours around climbing and training people.
